facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary steroid-reduction endpoint; some secondary signals · Phase 3 · efzofitimod in pulmonary sarcoidosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Study did not meet primary endpoint in change from baseline in mean daily OCS dose at week 48
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Study did not meet primary endpoint in change from baseline in mean daily OCS dose at week 48
evidence.safety: Efzofitimod was generally well-tolerated at both the 3.0 mg/kg and 5.0 mg/kg doses, consistent with a previously observed safety profile in all trials conducted to date
evidence.program_discontinued: Company plans to engage with the U.S. FDA to determine the path forward for efzofitimod in pulmonary sarcoidosis
